settings.reports.disc_fixed.hint: List prefixes that count as fixed costs (one per line). Trailing colon = whole subtree (e.g. 'Bills:' matches every Bills:* category). No colon = exact category name. Everything else → Discretionary.
settings.reports.disc_fixed.title: Discretionary vs. Fixed

settings.reports.income_sources.title: Income Sources Breakdown

settings.reports.vice.hint: Alcohol, smoking, vaping — whatever you track separately.

settings.scheduled.modal.err_required: Name, account, and amount are required

settings.scheduled.modal.subscription_li: When this template fires, the booked TX is auto-linked to the selected subscription.
settings.tags.modal.auto_tag_pointer: Auto-tag rules live in Settings → Auto-Tags.

settings.vehicles.confirm_delete: Delete vehicle "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
settings.vehicles.delete_blocked_tooltip: {{n}} fuel entries reference this vehicle. Archive instead, or delete the entries first.
settings.vehicles.delete_hint: Vehicles with fuel-log entries cannot be deleted. Archive them instead — archived vehicles are excluded from the per-vehicle selector but remain in historical reports.
settings.vehicles.empty: No vehicles configured. Click "Add Vehicle" to create one.
settings.vehicles.heading: Vehicles

setup.s1.hint: A display name shown in the header. The accent color tints buttons and links.
setup.s2.hint: Used for the empty-start seed and as the dashboard fallback. Three-letter ISO code.
setup.s3.hint: FinanceOS does not enforce auth itself — the chosen mode is honoured by reverse-proxies and the optional Basic-Auth middleware.
setup.s3.opt_none: None — no auth (only safe on a private LAN or behind your own VPN)
setup.s3.pass_hint: Min. 8 characters. Stored as bcrypt hash, never plaintext.
setup.s3.warn_confirm: I understand the risk and want to proceed without authentication.
setup.s3.warn_html: Warning: running with auth_mode=none means anyone who reaches the dashboard URL can view and edit your data. Make sure the server is on a private network.
setup.s4.hint: Choose how the data folder gets seeded.
setup.s4.opt_empty: Empty start — 4 generic accounts (cash / checking / savings / credit) + 34 neutral categories
setup.s4.opt_mmex: Import from Money Manager Ex — upload an .mmb file
setup.s5.feat_crdb: Bank reconciliation (CRDB) — monthly bank statement matching (specific to CRDB Bank)
setup.s5.feat_custom: Custom reports — user-defined reports with filter builder
setup.s5.feat_debt: Debt tracking — money lent to or owed by third parties with payment history
setup.s5.feat_metals: Precious metals — gold/silver portfolio with daily spot prices
setup.s5.feat_properties: Properties & utilities — per-house electricity/water tracking + Cost-of-Living-per-Property report. Best fit for prepaid-meter setups (e.g. LUKU electricity tokens, metered water) — configurable for any utility model
setup.s5.feat_pwa: Mobile PWA — offline-capable expense logging on phones
setup.s5.feat_quick: Quick expenses — chip shortcuts under Add TX for repeating cash purchases
setup.s5.feat_sched: Scheduled transactions — recurring TX templates (rent, salary, subscriptions)
setup.s5.feat_vehicles: Vehicles & fuel tracking — per-vehicle fuel log, consumption charts, drift alerts
setup.s5.hint: Turn on extras that aren't core. Can be changed later in config/features.json.
setup.s6.cust_hint: Pick from the categories that will be created. Tip: hold Ctrl / ⌘ to multi-select, type a letter to jump to the first match, scroll inside each box to see all options. Change everything later in Settings → Reports.
setup.s6.extra_summary: Don't see one of your categories? Add it manually
setup.s6.filter_ph: Type to filter all dropdowns (e.g. 'Income' or 'Bills')
setup.s6.hint: Nine reports filter by category — Dining Out, Bills, AI Costs, Vice Spending, Bank Fees, Cash Discrepancy, Automobile, Discretionary vs. Fixed, and Income Sources. Defaults match the canonical category set; customize now or later in Settings → Reports.
setup.s6.opt_customize: Customize now — pick which of your categories drive each report
setup.s6.opt_defaults: Use defaults — recommended unless you renamed a default category
setup.s7.alias_hint: Imported account names get auto-slugged into short aliases used everywhere in the system. Pick a type for each account so the dashboard groups it correctly (cash sits next to cash, credit cards stack together, custody / pass-through stay out of Net Worth). Aliases are lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only.
setup.s7.hint: Last check. Below is what will be written. Click Confirm to finalize.

tx.fx_converted_title: Converted using FX rate on {date} (fallback: month rate)
txflow.preview.heading: Preview
txp.bulk_op.account_conflict: {n} TX(s) don't match the target currency — no rows moved.
txp.bulk_op.account_currency_hint: Selected TXs are all in {ccy} — non-matching accounts are disabled.
txp.bulk_op.account_mixed_hint: Selection mixes currencies ({ccys}). The server will refuse unless all TXs match the target's currency.
txp.bulk_op.payee_hint: Overwrites the payee on every selected transaction. import_id stays the same so linked rows (subscriptions, fuel, utilities) remain intact.
txp.bulk_op.property_hint: Adds the property's cost_tag to every selected transaction.
txp.bulk_op.property_remove_hint: Strips the property's cost_tag from every selected transaction. Other tags are untouched.
txp.bulk_op.subscription_hint: Transactions already linked to a different subscription are skipped.
txp.bulk_op.subscription_unlink_hint: Removes the subscription link from every selected transaction. The transactions themselves stay untouched.
